content: Tamumwey yakamiy, kumtakavates Yowbad alen. Yey tamwey ma̱wan yakamiy, tage bo nakin Kelis ikanig waklos; o nakamnat igaw bitakines sigwey yakamiy mo bitamwa̱saws. Mapuna aguyeimiy va̱gan bukumtakavates Yowbad alen tasiyas nisesus wasigeis yakamiy. Biseiw nuwamiy silma̱nin wotet towen, awoum bukubgumats silma̱nin wotet. Kadiloka kutoukums. Awoum kuninuways maysan wotet, awoum. Awoum kuyakeikays wasigeis tasiyas, tage kadiloka kuva̱ges amisinap beibwein, va̱gan tasiyas bikaylasis amisinap.
Igaw towen tavakaein tamtakavatein alen mo bisap, mo bukuba̱nes amila̱lan silma̱nin mikamnat nag beikous.
Tabwa̱bwats yakamiy kwanawes ages tammwayas. Kumma̱nums tababaw yakamiy, simiyas wasigeis.

content.text: “Yowbad gog bisilbwades tasiyas takaypamweins sinap, tage bisiwyoubus tasiyas tamma̱nums.”

content: Yowbad Tatawtoun bikaliwageimiy, bweina bukumma̱nums wamatan, tutan ikakin-wan mo biyamweneimiy.
Aveiyag silma̱nin ikubukub nuwamiy. Bweina kuta̱mes kululuwamiy va̱gan Yowbad bimtakavet, peinan ikalin nuwan wasigeis yakamiy.
Kumtakavateimiy, kutitoukums. Tasilbwadeimiy towen Seitan ininoun ma̱wan la̱yon nakananeiy, sivinan kid beikam gamag.

Kusimounids beibwein waseg Yowbad, mo kusibwades mtowen Seitan. Kukwakinsa tayekelesiys babaw ven watinow bo bigeg abes ma̱wana yakamiy. Igaw abamiy bigeg tut kayakus waseg, tassiwa̱youb towen Yowbad mo bikatilow abamiy beibwein, bikimtuweimiy mo bukutawtouns, peinan bo ilivnakeimiy Kelis waseg silma̱nin nakamnat nag beikous.
Kadilokena bikaleiwag tut nag beikous. Eimen.
Bwadads mtowen Saylos, akakina tatitoukum towen. Bo ilabeig mo kalel milet towen kayakus, waseg bo aguyeimiy, akatimlakeimiy Yowbad nasiwa̱youb mounid towen; bweina bukuvvaluts nasiwa̱youb waseg.
Yowbad nikatigik-vak na̱tan vin mana̱wen nises Babilon. Mana̱wen vin anilivan siwa̱youb wasigeis yakamiy. Natug Mak anilivan-vak ma̱wan.
Misiwa̱youb waseg kumulouls simiyas wasigeis. Tababawa yakamiy, Kelis angamag yakamiy, niwal bises wasigeis yakamiy. Yey Pita.
